title: Measuring trainable degrees of freedom in materials graph neural networks: a random-subspace intrinsic dimension analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.36084v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Final predictive accuracy is the standard basis for comparing graph neural networks (GNNs) in materials-property prediction, but it does not show how strongly performance depends on access to trainable parameter-space directions. Here, we introduce trainable-degree dependence as a complementary characterization of materials GNN learning. Using random-subspace intrinsic-dimension analysis, we train CGCNN, ALIGNN, and DimeNet++ in randomly oriented parameter subspaces across six prediction tasks and measure how performance recovers as independent trainable degrees of freedom are restored. The resulting recovery curves separate endpoint accuracy from the trainable-dimensional demand required to recover it. translated_title: 测量材料图神经网络中的可训练自由度：一种随机子空间内在维度分析方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.36084v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：最终预测精度是比较材料性质预测中图神经网络（GNN）的标准基准，但它无法揭示性能在多大程度上依赖于对可训练参数空间方向的获取。在此，我们引入“可训练度依赖性”作为材料图神经网络学习的一种补充表征方法。利用随机子空间内在维度分析，我们在六个预测任务中于随机取向的参数子空间内训练 CGCNN、ALIGNN 和 DimeNet++，并测量随着独立可训练自由度的恢复，性能如何回升。由此得到的恢复曲线将终点精度与恢复该精度所需的可训练维度需求区分开来。它们揭示了仅凭最终误差无法察觉的区别：金属分类和对数体模量回归能从较小的分数子空间中恢复接近参考的性能，而形成能与带隙预测则表现出更强的……
tldr: 本文提出用随机子空间内在维度分析来衡量材料图神经网络的“可训练度依赖性”，发现不同材料性质预测任务（如金属分类、体模量回归与形成能、带隙预测）对可训练自由度的需求存在显著差异，为超越单纯最终精度的模型比较提供了互补视角。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "trainable-degree dependence" as a complementary characterization of materials GNNs, using random-subspace intrinsic-dimension analysis to reveal that different prediction tasks (e.g., metallic classification and log-bulk-modulus regression vs. formation energy and band gap) vary significantly in the trainable degrees of freedom required to recover reference performance.
